name: parmanu
description: India-first news and creator intelligence platform with verifiable provenance

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@parmanu/types build && npm run --workspace=@parmanu/web build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=@parmanu/types build && npm run db:generate && npm run --workspace=@parmanu/api typecheck && npm run --workspace=@parmanu/web build
